subject: Soft decline: invoice in collection - customer card update & partial-settlement option
messages:
From: Stripe Billing <stripe-billing@stripe.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.ai, billing@greenwave.com
Date: 2027-06-25 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Payment failed for Invoice in_7891 (soft_decline)

Hello,

We attempted to collect payment for invoice in_7891 (amount: $14,250.00) and the card was soft_declined by the issuer. Reason: 'transaction_not_allowed' / soft decline. We will attempt automatic retries according to your schedule.

Invoice: https://dashboard.stripe.com/invoices/in_7891
Attached: invoice_7891.pdf

If you need to update the payment method, please provide a new card or update via your customer portal.

– Stripe Billing

From: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
To: billing@greenwave.com
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-25 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment failed for Invoice in_7891 (soft_decline)

Hi Greenwave billing team —

Thanks for the heads up. We saw Stripe report a soft decline on invoice in_7891. Common causes are issuer soft-decline or temporary 3DS/processing issues. Quick options to get this resolved without impacting service:

- Update card via secure link (we can send one-click update).
- Split the invoice into two smaller charges and attempt a partial authorization (we can process $7,125 now, remainder on 7/9).
- Allow Stripe to run its retry schedule (we can also configure more aggressive retry attempts for this account).

Could you confirm if the cardholder can update the card now? If not, I'm proposing a split-invoice schedule (details attached) to reduce the chance of another soft decline.

Attached: invoice_7891.pdf

If you want the self-serve link, I can send it immediately.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: billing@greenwave.com
To: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-25 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment failed for Invoice in_7891 (soft_decline)

Hi Alex —

Thanks for flagging. I attached a screenshot from the cardholder (card-decline-screenshot.png) — they say their bank showed a temporary hold. The cardholder is traveling and can't update via phone today; they asked whether you can charge a smaller amount now and retry the rest later.

Would a split charge require a new invoice? Also, can you send the secure payment link that they can use from their phone when they are able?

Regards,
Jamie Torres
Billing Lead, Greenwave Analytics
billing@greenwave.com

From: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@greenwave.com
Date: 2027-06-25 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Payment failed for Invoice in_7891 — proposed split and link

Team — forwarding Greenwave's reply. They prefer a smaller immediate charge + remainder later because the cardholder is traveling. Proposed plan (attached spreadsheet): proposed-split-schedule.xlsx

Operational considerations:
- Stripe supports creating two invoices referencing the same order, or using two separate one-off charges tied to the customer. Either approach will generate separate settlement events and receipts.
- We can issue a $7,125 immediate charge and schedule a $7,125 follow-up on 2027-07-09. We'll need finance approval to create the second invoice and to accept split settlements (affects bookkeeping).
- Alternate: send Greenwave a one-click hosted payment link (PCI scope remains with Stripe) — fastest for customer to update card.

Can we approve the partial-settlement, and can finance create the second invoice template so we keep accounting aligned? If yes, I'll instruct Stripe to attempt the first charge now and hold the second until 7/9.

Thanks — Alex
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: alex_martinez@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-25 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Payment failed for Invoice in_7891 — proposed split and link

Alex / Priya —

Approved to proceed with a split settlement. Please do the following:
1) Create an immediate charge for $7,125 against customer record GW-CUST-1102 and issue receipt stamped to Greenwave Analytics.
2) Create a second invoice for the remaining $7,125 scheduled for 2027-07-09; add a memo 'pending settlement per customer request'.
3) Send the hosted payment update link to the cardholder so they can update the card; mark the account with 'manual follow-up' internal note.

We will reconcile both settlements to the same revenue event; accounting will accept split invoices for this customer. Priya — loop in collections if the follow-up charge fails.

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
